fieldValues.title: A problem may occur in several domains
fieldValues.decision_question: Can one problem belong to more than one domain, and be held by more than one persona?
fieldValues.context: Stated by the owner on 2026-10-16 while fixing personas: ten affirmed problems sit in two domain outlines (SP-01 to SP-04, SP-08, SP-28, SP-30, SP-31, SP-42, SP-43). The in-domain rule stays: each persona-in-domain is in exactly one domain.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We model a problem that occurs in several domains as one problem held by one persona-in-domain in each domain where it occurs, because held-by already allows several holders and a problem's domains are derived from its holders, never stored.
fieldValues.rationale: The same problem is experienced in different domains by different personas; cloning it would split one claim into copies that drift apart.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A problem means something different in one of its domains, so that one statement no longer fits both.
